Both helpers exist, but production remains fail-closed on section-aware compaction; head/tail is not emitted as a GPU treatment until malformed-prompt accounting is wired.
A paired public-vs-oracle localization panel is not yet materialized. Oracle-derived localization cannot become the headline condition.
V4.1 strict reference-pass/buggy-fail supervision is active. The older corpus is not a clean control because data and leakage policy changed together.
